title: The golden workbook's cached values contradict its own formulas, so an output recalculated in LibreOffice cannot match them even if its formulas are identical to the golden's.
confirmation: Golden 'Ex 1 - LBO' caches X24 = 8987.8 but Y24 = 8101.8 though both are =$F$21, AC17 (=U23) 1375.96 vs U23 1707.50, U41 (=+M17) 0.137 vs 0.092, C11 (=+C20) 18.2034 vs 14.2034, and 'Ex 5 - M&A' J75 18.2034 vs X75 17.81209 for the same formula; values-mode grading against these cannot be met by a rec
